SHITET OBJEKT BIZNESI 4-KATESH
* Ndodhet ne Kashar ne autostraden Tirane-Durres
* Siperfaqe ndertimit 2453.3 m2

* Eshte toke e rrethuar , e sistemuar mbi te cilen eshte nje ekonomi ndihmese bujqesore ,magazine dhe ne kendin e saje ka nje pishine me filtrim dhe qarkullim uji
* Ambiente te investuara dhe arreduar ne menyre perfekte si:
* salla per mbledhje ose konferencash te mobiluara dhe bosh
* zyra te mobiluara dhe bosh
* Ambiente me kushte perfekte per magazinim
* Dhoma frigoriferike
* Apartamente banimi
* Ambiente shlodhese dhe rekreative
* Infrastrukture dhe funksion te shkelqyer per hyrje dalje si nga Tirana, Durresi dhe Rinasi
* Gjelberim, privatesi
* Pishine me qarkullim dhe filtrim te ujit.
* Shkalle te brendeshme dhe me ashensor.
* Tavane te varura
* Kondicionim qendror.
* Gjenerator inverter me kapicitet per te gjithe objektin. 
* Oborr i madh per parkim makinash
* Dhe ambiente te tjera ndihmese per cdo lloj biznesi.
* Eshte i pershtatshem per cdo lloj biznesi, Kompani Elitare vendase dhe te Huaja, ne vecanti per Spital Privat per shkak te ambienteve lluksoze, etj.!
Cmimi 3 mln euro.

description_en: 4-FLOOR BUSINESS BUILDING FOR SALE * Located in Kashar on the Tirana-Durres highway * Building area 2453.3 m2 * Built on a land area of ​​4070 m2, which is surrounded and separated by two separate gates, where a building with a construction of 2453.3 m2 is built at the main gate. * Building base 683.8. * Vacant land 816.2 m2. * The other gate is divided into an area of ​​2570 m2. * It is a fenced, organized land on which there is an auxiliary agricultural economy, a warehouse and in its corner there is a swimming pool with filtration and water circulation * Perfectly invested and furnished premises such as: * furnished and empty meeting or conference rooms * furnished and empty offices * Environment with perfect conditions for storage * Refrigerated rooms * Residential apartments * Recreational and recreational facilities * Excellent infrastructure and function for entrance and exit from Tirana, Durres and Rinasi * Greenery, privacy * Swimming pool with water circulation and filtration. * Internal stairs and elevator. * Suspended ceilings * Central air conditioning. * Inverter generator with capacity for the entire facility. * Large yard for car parking * And other auxiliary facilities for any type of business. * It is suitable for any type of business, domestic and foreign elite companies, especially for private hospitals because of the luxurious facilities, etc.! The price is 3 million euros. TRS-18515812
